name: unify-mcp
description: Claude connector (MCP server) for the Unify SME booking platform

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build:vercel && node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings --test test/*.test.mjs
scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --format=esm --legal-comments=none --outfile=dist/index.js --banner:js="import{createRequire as __cr}from'module';const require=__cr(import.meta.url);" && esbuild src/http.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --format=esm --legal-comments=none --outfile=dist/http.js --banner:js="import{createRequire as __cr}from'module';const require=__cr(import.meta.url);"
